description: Adds one-pager generation and chat, with improvements to review navigation and GitLab discussion handling.
features: Generate and chat about reviewer-facing one-page merge-request summaries.
improvements: Open reviews on Overview by default and improve navigation between review sections and search matches.
Scope Claude and Codex one-pager writes to dedicated output directories.
Keep importance indicators visible and redistribute importance progress weights across all five levels.
fixes: Handle ranged GitLab discussion positions when line codes are absent, including explicit-null single-line ranges.
Preserve importance results and review drafts across concurrent updates.
Keep merged status visible on merged reviews.

description: Adds layer-importance scoring to code reviews and improves review navigation and GitLab discussion handling.
features: Score changed line spans for reviewer importance and show each score with a concise reason.
improvements: Show importance progress and per-file importance indicators during code review.
Show importance reasons on changed-file indicators.
fixes: Preserve multiline layer descriptions and independent concurrent review drafts.
Anchor ranged GitLab discussions to the selected-side range endpoint and accept explicit-null single-line ranges.

description: Adds release-note update notifications and full-path changed-file filtering, with review sync and navigation improvements.
features: Show release notes in a once-per-version update notification.
Filter changed files by case-insensitive full path.
improvements: Refresh review metadata and discussions during sync when merge request head is unchanged.
Use the latest Opus model by default for Claude reviews.
fixes: Route agent-authored Markdown file links to changed-file review navigation.
Add a right gutter to file Markdown previews.

description: Adds viewed-file chip highlighting and improves constrained diff toolbar layout.
features: Viewed layer files are highlighted without changing selected-chip styling.
fixes: Diff action toolbar stays on one line and scrolls horizontally when space is constrained.

description: Adds Codex reviews, versioned review skills, overview view, and update checks.
features: Codex can act as a review agent.
Create versioned skills in Settings and invoke them with slash commands in chat.
Review merge-request descriptions and general discussions, with actions to explain discussions in chat.
Show when a newer mole-tools release is available.
improvements: Configure review-agent model and reasoning effort.
Browse changed files in the review sidebar with improved navigation.
Persist collapsed comment state and move draft-mode controls into the header.
fixes: Fix Markdown inset and end stale sidebar splitter drags.

description: Expands review customization, chat-generated comments, and review workflow controls.
features: Select light theme, changed-files tree mode, folder-level progress controls, and whitespace visibility.
Generate anchored comment drafts from review chat.
improvements: Combine refresh, sync, and layer regeneration; show total diff stats; stop comment generation from its draft.
Add review favicon and tab title.
fixes: Hide noisy system-generated notes from general discussions.

description: Refines side-by-side diff sizing, inline diffs, and layer coverage layout.
improvements: Keep side-by-side diff columns aligned with fixed line-number and equal-width content columns.
Use dedicated layout for full-width inline diff tables.
Keep file coverage on one row with a flexible progress bar and visible viewed and total count.
Add regression coverage for diff table columns and layer coverage layout.

description: Improves viewed-file progress updates, review chat streaming, and review UI consistency.
improvements: Update viewed-file progress without reloading full review state, preserving diff, discussion, and approval data.
Keep review chat streaming stable across tool boundaries, busy and error states, and switched chats.
Polish segmented controls, layer progress, overflow handling, settings, headers, spacing, and review surfaces.

description: Streamlines review workspace, setup, review context, and file tagging.
features: Rework review layout with a compact merge-request header, review-layer column, changed-file progress, viewed-file tracking, and agent controls.
Default interactive review to Claude and create the parent directory during first-run config setup.
Provide review discussion context to the first chat turn.
Add path-only chat tags for binary, collapsed, renamed, deleted, and stat-only files.
Render sanitized Markdown previews for review comments.
improvements: Highlight multiline diff syntax by tokenizing complete hunks.
Remove BDD scenario generation while retaining layer coverage and lifecycle behavior.

description: Fixes activation of the explanation prompt preset.
fixes: The active review-explain-comment preset is now honored by the Explain discussion flow.

description: Adds prompt presets, review settings, discussion explanations, and review workflow refinements.
features: Manage named prompt presets and versions, and configure review agent and model in Prompts and Models.
Explain inline and general GitLab discussions in a new chat with discussion history and surrounding diff context.
improvements: Collapse positioned discussion bodies per file.
Scroll selected changed-file rows into view and synchronize Viewed state with persisted progress.
Use clearer chat composer key behavior and collapsible review layers.
Show concise layer file paths and reviewed commit SHA.
Bound review-layer prompt context with configurable byte limits.
Avoid duplicate Git repository-root discovery during merge-request environment handoff.
fixes: Replace cramped diff toolbar controls with compact icons and show find-result navigation only after search starts.

description: Adds drag-to-select for tags and comments and a review babysitter.
features: Select tags and comments by dragging.
Add a review babysitter.

description: Patch release with no separately listed user-facing changes.
Adds diff-file search, whole-file viewing, and merge-request description modes.
features: Find text in files from the diff view.
Reveal whole files in the diff viewer.
Choose merge-request description modes.

description: Improves rendered Markdown review, agent tools, clone authentication, and Claude session resumption.
features: Syntax-highlight rendered file code and add tag and comment actions to rendered blocks.
Allow review agents to use a read-only Bash tool.
improvements: Preserve rendered Mermaid diagrams across background refreshes and allow wide tables to scroll.
Resolve review repositories with SSH URLs to avoid interactive GitLab credential prompts.
Resume Claude sessions with the CLI resume option.
fixes: Ignore rate_limit_event provider events instead of reporting unknown-event diagnostics.

description: Adds GitLab merge-request review, AI generation context, and validated automatic commits.
features: Review GitLab merge requests in a token-protected local UI with generated layers, diff view, persistent agent chat, positioned discussion drafts, approval controls, and stale-head refresh.
Add context guidance to AI commit and merge-request generation, including retry paths.
Create validated local commits non-interactively with commit auto.
improvements: Improve nested boolean option detection and CLI help rendering.
Improve GitLab reviewer resolution, Pi iteration handoffs, and cost aggregation and session parsing.
Simplify installer asset naming and expand configuration and architecture documentation.
